description: Summarises failed and errored web automation tests in a date range: counts by failure category and by status, and the failing tests themselves with build and environment. Failure categories exist only for about the last 7 days of tests; older failures are counted as uncategorised.

fromDate.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 59 days (older results are not served). Defaults to 30 days before toDate.

limit.description: Maximum failing tests to list, 1 to 200. Defaults to 20.

toDate.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

name: getAnalyticsErrors
title: Get Analytics Errors
